exposure: enhanced postnatal neonatal jaundice health education program
outcome: maternal perspectives and preferences for the education program
uptake and sustainability of health education programs
cohort: 12 postnatal women who had taken part in an enhanced neonatal jaundice education program.
finding: The enhanced neonatal jaundice education program was positively perceived by women and preferred compared to conventional health education methods, with key facilitators including the augmented nature of the intervention, sorting individual needs, and ability to promote continuity of care and care-seeking.
